title: 9.2.1 | Bugfix Patch
body: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/4229a1dcaa22e19074471663634773460a02ca75.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Content Updates[/b][/h2][h3][b]The Krasue[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Increased the initial number of Glowing Fungus to [b]5[/b] [i](was 4)[/i] and decreased the maximum number to [b]6[/b] [i](was 8).[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Decreased the time during which Intestinal Whip ignores obstructions to [b]0.35 seconds[/b] [i](was 0.6)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the Head Form pallet vault time to [b]2 seconds[/b] [i](was 1.7)[/i] and the Head Form window vault time to [b]1.8[/b] [b]seconds[/b] [i](was 1.7)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the Head Form pallet stun time to [b]2.5 seconds[/b] [i](was 2)[/i]. [/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][h3][b]Audio[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Krasue was missing SFX when grabbing a Survivor from a locker.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Orela's voiceover was missing from the the Killer POV when unhooked.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Animatronic's footsteps were louder than intended.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where some of The Krasue's SFX were not synced up with their animations.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Krasue's SFX were missing when performing an Intestinal Whip on any collision.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where some haptic feedback was missing for The Krasue.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where static could be heard during the Entombment Rift Pass trailer in-game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Unknown's Mori voiceover plays from the incorrect direction.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Bots[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed multiple issues where Survivor bots would not finish healing other Survivors.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Characters[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Carlos Oliveira, Chris Redfield, Claire Redfield, and Sheva Alomar Legendary outfits did not have unique campfire animations.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Shape's hand was misaligned with the Survivor's neck during his Mori.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Rain Carradine's campfire animation did not play correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the camera remained pointed downward after closing the hatch as The Ghoul.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where a score event was missing for The Ghoul when performing a Kagune Leap on a Survivor.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Houndmaster's dog could despawn and respawn during a Chase Command.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Nightmare could teleport out of bounds when teleporting to a Survivor healing at the Exit Gate.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Knight could initiate a chase before teleporting back to his original location after summoning a Guard.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Knight could briefly see Survivors and scratch marks when teleporting back to his location after spawning a Guard.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Security Doors would appear misaligned with their doorframes when The Animatronic exited one after a jump scare.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Dark Lord's camera could become misaligned when transforming.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Survivor character models would disappear from The Executioner's Cage of Atonement after being sacrificed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Xenomorph was unable to see the Entity's claws on blocked generators while inside a tunnel.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Killers could receive permanent Killer Instinct on a Survivor.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Lich's Flight of the Damned projectiles disappeared upon reaching map boundaries.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Artist's crow projectiles disappeared upon reaching map boundaries.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Characters - The Krasue [/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the animation for Survivors eating a Glowing Fungus was missing.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the animation of The Krasue snuffing out a totem would not play properly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Survivors were misaligned during locker grabs and when being dropped by The Krasue.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Krasue's spectator camera was misaligned after performing a Mori.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Glowing Fungus would clip into Survivors' hands.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Glowing Fungus could spawn under dropped pallets.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Glowing Fungus VFX would remain after it was destroyed by a pallet.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Krasue's hair would stutter from the Survivor POV when being carried in Head Mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Krasue's Headlong Flight's icon cooldown would briefly appear full when a generator was completed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Krasue's Headlong Flight vignette would remain visible in spectator mode after finishing this action.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Glowing Fungus cleansing effect would stop if a Survivor lost a health state by any means other than a hit from the Killer or Deep Wound.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the "Re-Leeched" score event was missing when the Glowing Fungus effect was interrupted by The Krasue's Regurgitate.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Krasue's Regurgitate reticle remained visible after being stunned with a pallet.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Krasue's Theatre Binoculars add-on would only reveal Survivor auras when they had zero Leech progress.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Krasue could push Survivor when transitioning between forms.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Krasue's intestines would stretch when destroying a breakable wall.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Environment/Maps[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue in the Dead Dawg Saloon map where players were unable to navigate through a gap as intended.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in the Dead Dawg Saloon map where a balcony vault was inaccessible to Survivors.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in the Lampkin Lane map where the leaves of trees would clip through the walls.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in the Autohaven Wreckers Realm where a tree would block a vault.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed multiple issue where the camera would clip through The Houndmaster at the beginning of a Trial.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in the Coldwind Farm Realm where a tree would spawn through objects.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in The Game map where The Nurse could Blink out of bounds.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in the Mother's Dwelling map where The Krasue's camera while in Head Form would clip through walls.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in the Ormond Lake Mine map where The Skull Merchant's drones were unable to detect Survivors on the outside ramp or upper level of the main building.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in various maps where The Krasue's Glowing Fungus was not able to spawn in some intended places.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in various maps where The Krasue's Glowing Fungus was able to spawn on top of objects.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in the Red Forest Realm where an invisible ramp was present.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in the Autohaven Wreckers Realm where player could not use the vault in the magnet crane.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in the Pale Rose map where a fire barrel was clipping inside a generator, making it unusable.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Perks[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where a token from Play With Your Food was removed when The Krasue used Regurgitate.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Krasue's Head Form aura remained visible to Survivors while having Alert and Eyes of Belmont equipped.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Plot Twist could trigger Mettle of Man's activation requirements.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the debuff icon was missing when affected by Forced Hesitation.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Survivors could hear the audio cue on Territorial Imperative.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Potential Energy remained toggled on when moving to another generator.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Solidarity would not apply after a med-kit ran out of charges in the middle of a heal.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Road Life gained tokens when affected by The Animatronic's Office Phone add-on.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where ONE-TWO-THREE-FOUR! affected The Pig's Jigsaw Boxes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where ONE-TWO-THREE-FOUR! affected The Lich's Mimic Chests.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where ONE-TWO-THREE-FOUR!'s tambourine would grow increasingly larger if used with the Hand of Vecna equipped.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where ONE-TWO-THREE-FOUR! took priority over Reassurance when within the 6m radius of a hooked Survivor.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where ONE-TWO-THREE-FOUR! took priority over Invocation: Treacherous Crows and Invocation: Weaving Spiders when within the circle.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Platforms[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Sinister Grace DLC was not linked in-game on Steam and Epic Games Store.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the match end audio would play on the Tally Screen when quitting or abandoning a match on Epic Games Store.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Quests[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the progress for "Heal 2 Survivors From the Dying State" was counted twice when fully recovering from the Dying State.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]UI[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Twins’ power and add-ons were not displayed in the Match Details screen when controlling Victor.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the player info boxes in a Custom Match lobby were misaligned.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the matchmaking status text could overlap with the event button in the Quests menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the slugging and tunneling reduction features were visible in the Custom Match Settings Modified popup despite not being available.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the depleted item icon would appear replenished when dropping a Glowing Fungus.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Miscellaneous[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the status of the autoplay checkbox in The Tomes to not be saved when rebooting the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that caused a crash when switching between tabs in the Store.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where anonymous mode would disable licensed music when active.[/p][/*][/list]
